span.label: method
span.quote: We propose a new system for generating art.

span.label: machine generation of creative visual art
span.quote: The goal of this paper is to investigate a computational creative system for art generation without involving a human artist in the creative process, but nevertheless involving human creative products in the learning process.

span.label: system-or-tool-building
span.quote: We propose a model for an art-generating agent, and then propose a functioning model using a variant of GAN to make it creative.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: modify the GAN objective to push generated images to deviate from established style norms while staying near the art distribution
span.quote: force the system to explore creative space to find solutions that deviate from established styles but stay close enough to the boundary

span.label: GANs have a fundamental limitation in generating genuinely creative works
span.quote: the fundamental limitation of using GANs in generating creative works

span.label: Creativity of machine-generated artifacts is acknowledged to be an unresolved assessment problem.
span.quote: Assessing the creativity of artifacts generated by the machine is an open and hard question.

span.label: Creativity was operationalised only as novelty, because influence could not be measured.
span.quote: However, since influence is not relevant here, we use novelty as a proxy for creativity.

span.label: The system has no semantic understanding of art beyond style categories.
span.quote: However it does not have any semantic understanding of art behind the concept of styles.

span.label: The authors cannot explain why subjects rated CAN images above the human Art Basel set.
span.quote: We leave open how to interpret the human subjects’ responses that ranked the CAN art better than the Art Basel samples in different aspects.

span.label: Further experiments are needed to settle the interpretation of the results.
span.quote: More experiments are definitely needed to help answer these questions.

span.label: style ambiguity - AS POSTERIOR ENTROPY: the generator is rewarded for making the style classifier uncertain, so 'deviating from style norms' is implemented as producing images the classifier cannot place, and creativity becomes a property of a confusion matrix
span.quote: We added a style classification loss and a style ambiguity loss. Maximizing the stylistic ambiguity can be achieved by maximizing the style class posterior entropy

span.label: novelty - INHERITED FROM BERLYNE'S COLLATIVE VARIABLES: it is one of five arousal-raising properties named in an aesthetics theory - novelty, surprisingness, complexity, ambiguity and puzzlingness - and this system implements the fourth of them while the record's limitation says creativity was operationalised as the first
span.quote: Berlyne emphasized that the most significant arousal-raising properties for aesthetics are novelty, surprisingness, complexity, ambiguity, and puzzlingness. He coined the term collative variables to refer to these properties collectively
